cards.title: World Notes: How Knights Were Made
cards.sub: A real thing behind the story
cards.todo: Read the note. Then read the chapter with your lens in mind.
text: Long ago in Europe, a king or queen could make a brave person a knight.
The new knight knelt, and the ruler touched his shoulder with the flat side of a sword. This is called an accolade.
Then he was called Sir. The king of the United Kingdom still makes knights today, with a touch of a sword on each shoulder.

transcripts.welcome: Hi, it's Opti. The children meet Aslan, and Peter has to be brave. Watch what Peter does in Chapter 12.
transcripts.guide1: Word work: build together words, put apostrophes in place, and build words with endings.
transcripts.guide2: Read Chapter 12. Then answer three questions.
transcripts.guide3: Today you add your symbol paragraph to your response.

notes.wordParts: The word parts com- and con- both mean with or together. combine = to join together. connect = to tie together.
notes.grammar: An apostrophe has two jobs. It joins two words: did + not = didn’t. It shows belonging: Lucy’s bottle is the bottle that belongs to Lucy.
notes.spelling: Some endings change the base word. Double the last letter: run → running. Drop the silent e: hope → hoping. Change y to i: carry → carried.
notes.wgrd: Peter uses the sword Father Christmas gave him. Aslan makes him a knight. The gift was a sign of what Peter would need to do.
vocab: made new again; restored to a fresh state
a person or thing that announces something important is coming

mods.script: Let's fix a sentence. The correct one first. Susan's horn rang out, and Peter ran to help, but Aslan's order meant the others didn't join the fight. Susan's and Aslan's show belonging. Didn't joins two words. Tap the yellow parts. Then pick Sentence A or Sentence B, and type it the right way.

mods.script: Snap the parts together. Con. Tact. Contact! When two things are in contact, they touch together. Say each pair of parts out loud. Type the whole word in the box. Then tap Check My Answers.

mods.todo: Read each sentence. Pick the word that fits.
mods.script: Try each word in the blank, and keep the one that makes sense. Here's my sentence. After a long nap, my grandpa felt blank. Herald? Hmm, no. Renewed? Yes! Now pick the word that fits each sentence.

mods.todo: Read the before and after. Put the apostrophes in the gray sentence.
mods.script: Let's be the editor. The dwarfs whip wasnt kind to the reindeer. Dwarf's needs an apostrophe: the whip belongs to the dwarf. Wasn't needs one too: was, plus not. Read the before and after, and tap Check yourself. Then fix the sentence in the gray box.

items.t: Peter tells Aslan that Edmund going wrong was partly his own fault, because he was angry with him.
items.why: He owns up to his part, even in front of Aslan.

items.t: Mr. Beaver tells Aslan plainly that Edmund has joined the White Witch.
items.why: He tells the truth, even though it is sad news.

items.t: Aslan tells Lucy that saving Edmund may be harder than she thinks.
items.why: He does not pretend it will be easy.
